x-e-m1-01.title: Vai Bens ieradīsies ballītē? Viņa atbilžu slēptās nozīmes izpēte

x-e-m1-01.material:
Dialogs starp Jisu un Benu (tikai tekstā, bez attēliem):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Bens: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Bens: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Bens: Let me check with my mom first.
